description: P020 cond 5: per-resolver block signatures. A name is BLOCKED by a resolver only when the filtered A answer matches its signature (every address in 'sinks', the 'nxdomain' rule, or an RFC 8914 Extended DNS Error in 'ede') AND the unfiltered core DoH reference resolves the name. 'nxdomain': null = an NXDOMAIN is never a block signature, 'any' = every NXDOMAIN is, 'no_soa' = only an NXDOMAIN without an SOA in the authority section. 'verified': 'documented' (vendor documentation), 'research' (research record, not reproduced live) or 'generic' (the generic web-check rule).
source: V3LUM-authored from vendor documentation and the research records C0036 (2026-11-25/26); the generic sink set and the 'blocked only when the reference resolves' rule follow web-check api/block-lists.js (MIT), reimplemented, no code copied.

cloudflare_security.evidence: Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 for Families documentation: names blocked by 1.1.1.2 (malware) answer 0.0.0.0 (A) and :: (AAAA).

cloudflare_family.evidence: Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 for Families documentation: 1.1.1.3 (malware + adult content) answers blocked names with 0.0.0.0 / ::.

quad9.evidence: Research gh_infra (C0036): Quad9 answers blocked names NXDOMAIN without an SOA; a real NXDOMAIN carries the zone SOA (live nic.br answer, 2026-11-26).

adguard_default.evidence: AdGuard DNS default blocking mode answers 0.0.0.0 / ::; 94.140.14.35 is the block page address per the research record (not reproduced live). AdGuard JSON answers carry no Authority section, so NXDOMAIN is never a signature.

adguard_family.evidence: As AdGuard default (ads + adult content); safe-search CNAME rewrites are not blocks.

opendns.evidence: Cisco Umbrella block pages 146.112.61.104-110 (research C0036; the category of each address is not verified). OpenDNS does not hijack NXDOMAIN (live nic.br answer carries the SOA).

opendns_familyshield.evidence: As OpenDNS standard (Cisco Umbrella block-page range).

cleanbrowsing_security.evidence: Generic web-check rule (sink addresses or NXDOMAIN while the reference resolves); not verified for CleanBrowsing, whose free filters may not be used by organisations.
